reference_role: Style and composition reference: illustration category artwork
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one standalone landscape category thumbnail for a desktop character illustration app, landscape aspect ratio 3:2.
Input image: supplied screenshot is ONLY a visual style and composition reference. Recreate ONLY the artwork seen inside the second small category card marked '일러스트' near the bottom. Do not reproduce the screenshot or the interface.
Primary request: a vivid blue sky with billowing cream-white clouds above a lush green fantasy valley, a distant tiny village, rolling hills, and framing leafy trees. Painterly, detailed fantasy anime landscape with serene afternoon sunlight. Focal valley in center; strong clear blue and green colors and a readable composition when displayed at 165 by 100 pixels. Soft warm sunlight on fields and buildings.
Composition: wide view into the valley from a grassy foreground, sky occupying upper half, little village in the middle distance. The entire image is artwork.
Constraints: no UI, no lettering, no text, no labels, no card border, no frame, no watermark, no people. Opaque background.
inspection: Verified: standalone opaque fantasy anime landscape; vivid blue sky, cream clouds, green valley, village; no interface, letters, borders or watermark.
